Resolves #19377

ADR-0034 §2.3 item 10 now states the setup effect channel as it shipped: `setupEffect` runs the one consented host effect through the Brain's shared orchestration and answers the re-evaluated run, an orchestration refusal answers `{ok: false, reason, effectId}` and writes nothing, and only a shell that cannot run effects at all hands the operator the CLI. The Custody paragraph gains the broker's read-from-disk rule. The dated "as recorded here, the handler refuses every call" sentence and the `unwired` name are gone. The contract it documents merged as neomjs/neo-agent-institution#464 (Institution `dev@424fa0e`).

Evidence: L1 (the record's text, read against the merged broker source) → L1 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3). No residuals.
